> About

SqueekBlockNFT is the official NFT collection for SqueekChain.

🐹 v1 note: This is the initial release with block data cards. NFT art will be improved in future versions — stay tuned.

What is SqueekChain?

SqueekChain is a hamster-powered proof-of-work toychain on Ethereum Sepolia testnet. A hamster named Squeektoshi runs on the WHEELY9000 wheel. Each magnet passage is one work unit, settled to Ethereum as Squeek blocks, issuing SQK tokens.

What is a Block Data Card?

Each SqueekBlockNFT represents one block on SqueekChain. The card displays on-chain data: block number, round, work units, and rarity. It's a verifiable record of the hamster's work.

Rarity Tiers

Legendary — Blocks #1-#10
Epic — Blocks #11-#100
Rare — Blocks #101-#1,000
Milestone — Every 1,000th block
Notable — Every 100th block
Common — Everything else

How to Mint

  1. Connect your wallet — site auto-switches to Sepolia testnet
  2. Get Sepolia ETH from a faucet (alchemy.com/faucets, sepoliafaucet.com)
  3. Pick any block #1-#10,000 that has been mined
  4. Click Mint — your NFT appears instantly

Contract

Deployed on Sepolia testnet. All art is generated fully on-chain via SVG. No IPFS, no external dependencies.
